verdict.rationale: Lorikeet lets users build and deploy workflows that its agent runs end-to-end without a human. Outbound campaigns run on cadences with scheduling windows, which gives recurring background execution, and Coach reviews 100% of tickets and can implement improvements on the user's behalf. However, most automation shown reacts to incoming customer conversations, and general-purpose background automation is only implied. Missing for 10: documented user-defined triggers or schedules beyond outbound campaigns, detail on configuring and monitoring background runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
